verdict.rationale: Browserbase is a browser-automation and scraping platform, so honoring robots.txt and target-site rate limits is a fair question for it. However, no evidence item mentions robots.txt compliance or automatic per-site throttling. The claims about high concurrency, scheduling and CAPTCHA handling are adjacent features and do not deliver polite-crawling controls.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can configure the crawler to respect robots.txt rules and target-site rate limits automatically
